announcements.headline: Admission to Trading and PDMR Transaction
announcements.insight: A director transaction follows the recent RSU awards. This reflects standard post-admission activity rather than a strategic shift.

New Awards under the Restricted Share Unit (“RSU”) Plan and the Stock Option Plan

announcements.headline: Readmission - Amaroq Ltd.
announcements.insight: Readmission follows the July prospectus and resource update, confirming the completion of the listing process for shareholders.

announcements.headline: Amaroq
announcements.insight: Amaroq Ltd. has published a prospectus alongside an updated mineral resource estimate and competent persons report. This suggests progress in preparing for a capital raise or listing following the resource update.

announcements.headline: Updated Mineral Resource Estimate and publication of Competent Persons Report
announcements.insight: Amaroq Ltd updates its mineral resource estimate following the July prospectus publication. Shareholders should monitor for subsequent funding or development steps.

announcements.headline: Publication of Prospectus
announcements.insight: Amaroq Ltd. has published a prospectus, indicating a potential capital raise or listing process. Shareholders should monitor for further details on the transaction's terms and structure.
